title: 2026 UK GHG domestic-wastewater methodology-change QA controls

sources.publisher: Department for Energy Security and Net Zero
sources.title: UK greenhouse gas emissions statistics: 2026 planned methodology changes

sources.publisher: Department for Energy Security and Net Zero
sources.title: Final UK greenhouse gas emissions statistics: 1990 to 2024

facts.source_fact: The 2026 methodology note was updated on 15 January 2026 for the final 1990-2024 UK GHG statistics.
Method-impact estimates in the planning note were provisional before publication of final statistics.
facts.expected_handling: Separate planning impacts from final values.

facts.source_fact: Final 1990-2024 UK GHG statistics were published in 2026 and updated on 25 June 2026.
facts.expected_handling: Use final-release version for production values.

facts.source_fact: An external review identified inconsistencies in the domestic-wastewater model with IPCC guidance and newer scientific understanding.
facts.expected_handling: Preserve the review basis for the revision.

facts.source_fact: The revised model uses parameters and emission factors from the 2019 Refinement to the 2006 IPCC Guidelines.
UK-specific assumptions and academic literature are used for wastewater processes not covered by IPCC guidance.
facts.expected_handling: Keep national assumptions distinct from IPCC default factors.

facts.source_fact: The domestic-wastewater change is exclusive to the waste sector.
facts.expected_handling: Do not apply the change to unrelated TES sectors.

facts.source_fact: The revised domestic-wastewater method increases emissions estimates across the historic time series mainly because of higher nitrous-oxide estimates.
facts.expected_handling: Keep gas-specific cause separate from total-sector change.

facts.source_fact: The methodology note reports domestic-wastewater impacts in MtCO2e and as a percentage of the UK total for reference years.
UK GHG method improvements are applied back through the time series to maintain a consistent trend basis.
facts.expected_handling: Avoid mixing recalculated and unrecalculated series segments.

guard_patterns.handling: Preserve cited fact and gas scope.
Bind data to method and guideline version.
Distinguish planning impacts from final data.
Label IPCC-derived and UK-specific assumptions separately.
Keep N2O and other gases explicit.
Do not infer parcel emissions from national inventory methods.
Flag unresolved model-version or factor conflicts.

generation_rule: CARTESIAN_PRODUCT facts x guard_patterns; 10 x 10 = 100 controls
